sounds.usage: Main CTA, navigation and selected button hover (pointerenter, fine pointers only)
sounds.prompt: A very short premium digital interface hover sound. A soft glassy tactile tick with a tiny high-frequency shimmer, clean and restrained, subtle modern technology feel, very quiet, almost imperceptible, no voice, no music, no ambience.

sounds.usage: Primary CTAs and important navigation actions
sounds.prompt: A precise premium user interface button click, a short muted mechanical tactile press with a subtle low-frequency body and a clean digital finish, polished modern hardware interface, no long reverb, no voice, no music.

sounds.usage: Secondary buttons, dropdown selection, wishlist, small controls
sounds.prompt: A very short soft digital confirmation click, minimal tactile glass interaction with a controlled high-frequency detail, understated and professional, no music, no voice, no reverberation.

sounds.usage: Add to cart (cards, product page, Buy now)
sounds.prompt: A refined two-stage digital commerce confirmation sound, beginning with a soft tactile click followed immediately by a small warm ascending glassy electronic chime, clean premium marketplace interaction, short and satisfying, no music, no voice.

sounds.usage: Genuinely successful operations only (saved storefront, created store, accepted policy)
sounds.prompt: A short elegant two-note ascending digital success chime, smooth rounded glass-like tones, warm and reassuring, premium modern technology product interface, soft attack and quick natural decay, no voice, no music.

sounds.usage: Search panel, category mega menu, filter sheet and dialogs opening
sounds.prompt: A subtle short airy digital interface transition, a soft controlled upward whoosh with a delicate smooth tonal texture, modern premium software interface, no dramatic sweep, no music, no voice.

sounds.usage: Error toasts: validation errors and failed operations
sounds.prompt: A short restrained interface error notification, a muted low two-tone digital buzz with a soft tactile character, clear but not alarming, professional modern UI sound, no harsh distortion, no music, no voice.

sounds.usage: Notifications and order updates (wired once the notification system exists)
sounds.prompt: A delicate single digital notification chime, bright but soft, short glassy electronic tone with a gentle rounded finish, clean premium technology interface, no music, no voice.

sounds.usage: Major navigation only: marketplace to Merchant Studio and back
sounds.prompt: A minimal short airy interface transition sound, a smooth subtle digital sweep with a soft descending tonal texture, premium contemporary technology experience, gentle and unobtrusive, no music, no voice.
